prompt: Create a cute transparent-background sticker illustration of a happy cartoon cactus in a terracotta flower pot. The cactus is bright lime green, glossy, and rounded, with one large central oval barrel cactus body and exactly two raised side arms, one on each side, shaped like curved saguaro arms. Add dark green rib lines and soft highlights on every cactus segment. The face is centered on the main cactus: two large black oval eyes with white sparkle highlights, two small curved closed-looking eyebrow marks above them, round pink blush cheeks, and a wide open smiling mouth with a dark interior and pink tongue. Place a single red-pink flower on top-left of the cactus crown, with exactly 6 rounded petals and a yellow center made of small bead-like dots. Cover the cactus with many small star-shaped pale yellow spines emerging from tiny orange bumps, distributed across the main body and both arms. The pot is orange terracotta with a thick rounded rim, darker red-orange shading, subtle speckles, and glossy white highlights; show brown soil and several rounded pebbles visible above the rim. Use a kawaii vector sticker style with thick dark green outlines, soft gradients, high saturation, clean edges, and a bold white sticker border around the whole cactus and pot. The image should sit on a transparent checkerboard background, centered, with no text, no watermark, and no extra objects.

promptZh: 创作一张可爱的透明背景贴纸插图，主体是一个放在赤陶花盆里的快乐卡通仙人掌。仙人掌呈明亮的青柠绿色，具有光泽感且圆润，中心是一个大型椭圆形桶状仙人掌主体，两侧各有一个向上抬起的侧臂，形状如同弯曲的巨人柱仙人掌手臂。在每个仙人掌部分添加深绿色纹理线条和柔和的高光。面部位于主仙人掌中心：两只带有白色闪光高光的大型黑色椭圆形眼睛，上方有两道弯曲的眉毛，圆圆的粉色腮红，以及一个张开的笑脸，内部为深色并露出粉色舌头。在仙人掌顶部左侧放置一朵红粉色花朵，花朵有 6 片圆润的花瓣，中心是由小珠状圆点组成的黄色花蕊。在仙人掌主体和两侧手臂上覆盖许多从微小橙色凸起中长出的淡黄色星形刺。花盆为橙色赤陶材质，带有厚实的圆润边缘、深红橙色阴影、细微的斑点和光泽的白色高光；在盆口上方展示棕色土壤和几颗圆润的鹅卵石。采用卡哇伊矢量贴纸风格，带有粗厚的深绿色轮廓、柔和的渐变、高饱和度、干净的边缘，并在整个仙人掌和花盆周围加上醒目的白色贴纸边框。图像应置于透明的棋盘格背景上，居中对齐，无文字，无水印，且无额外物体。
